inputs_in_tool_order.role: target: supplied environment and existing contents
identity: canonical female and illustrated rendering

environment_medium: Supplied realistic rendered office appearance, preserved; no new conversion requested
source_state: One vacant central black chair behind a foreground wooden desk. Monitor/webcam at right; window with sunset at upper right; warm existing wall and shelf lighting; wall signs, plants, books and globe. Desk has one shield award, one mug, one notebook with pen, one closed laptop, one headset and a small front dock. Dense existing Legacy and Allstate branding/text remains part of supplied environment, with no added marks requested. Attachment origin beyond user supply is unknown.
placement: Seat one female naturally in the existing central chair. Face and upper torso clearly visible. Hips on seat and back supported; head near/slightly above chair-back top at normal adult scale; shoulders within chair bolsters. Forearms relaxed on armrests. Existing desk and props occlude lower body and any appropriate hand portions; no forced visible feet or tail through desk.
consequential: Exactly one recognizable canonical female with master proportions, plain black shirt and illustrated rendering
Existing chair supports body naturally; correct desk/prop occlusion and no clipping
Preserve supplied environment medium, camera, framing and major contents
Match window-right warm light and existing room light, local contact shadows and perspective
No added branding, props or extra people
One request and one untouched raw output
perceptually_important: Master face, golden hair, ears, eye/muzzle relationships and restrained blunt hands
Visible collar remains the simple rounded neckline of master, no invented polo/placket/buckle
Chair and monitor stay distinct; avoid hiding face behind monitor
Existing desktop objects keep their positions and counts
Unoccluded existing text/emblems retain their source appearance
incidental_allowed_variation: Fine hair strands and shirt folds
Local light tint/contact shadows caused by added character
Existing background regions necessarily occluded by seated character
input_boundary: Seated integration with desk occlusion is harder than open-floor placement. Visible upper body and support/contact can be assessed; hidden hips/legs/feet cannot be directly verified. Existing small text and emblem fidelity can drift.

branding.existing_marks_policy: Preserve supplied marks and placements, with legitimate character occlusion allowed. Do not replace them using a different logo source.

redesign_envelope: Add character plus physically necessary local occlusion/contact/light interaction only. No office redesign, camera movement, scene stylization, new logo or character wardrobe redesign.
